entities.name: Pantothenate synthetase
observations: The 285-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt references Q04S98 and Q050C4; annotated as EC 6.3.2.1.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent condensation of (R)-pantoate and beta-alanine via a pantoyl-adenylate intermediate.

entities.name: Pantothenate synthesis
observations: Rhea RHEA:10912: (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine + ATP = (R)-pantothenate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+).
